note: Issue 449, contacts.md section 3: every acknowledgement says what happened, and none describes an outcome the sim did not carry out. Acting alone on an urging, he keeps his own intent; the urging is never installed.

body.text: You will wish to know, though you did not ask, that I have kept {param:town} to {param:own}, whatever your letter said of {param:what}.
I did not think it could wait on the tide. I am confident you would have come to the same place, given a month.
